```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

options(scipen = 999)

month_data <- file_check |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

#connect to data warehouse
db <- RPostgreSQL::dbConnect(RPostgreSQL::PostgreSQL(),
                 dbname = dbname, 
                 host = host, 
                 port = port, 
                 user = user, 
                 password = password)

```

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "utility_table"}

SELECT DISTINCT utility_name, mn_utility_id AS utility_id
FROM energy.utility_info 

```

Check for duplicate entries

```{r, echo = FALSE}

dup_check <- month_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = paste(utility_id, month, customer_type, as.character(report_year), sep = "_")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(row_id) |>
  dplyr::mutate(count = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::filter(count > 1)

if(nrow(dup_check) == 0){

  print("No duplicates found")

} else{

  print("The following rows are duplicates")

  DT::datatable(dup_check)

}
  
```

Check that all customer types are valid

```{r, echo = FALSE}

valid_units  <- c("Non-Farm Residential",
                  "Residential With Space Heat",
                  "Farm",
                  "Small Commercial & Industrial",
                  "Large Commercial & Industrial",
                  "Street & Highway Lighting",
                  "Other (Include Municipals)",
                  "Irrigation",
                  "Mining",
                  "Total"
)

unit_check <- month_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(!c(customer_type %in% valid_units))

if(nrow(unit_check) == 0){
  
  print("All customer types are valid")
  
} else{
  
  DT::datatable(unit_check)
  
}

```

Check if utilities have valid MWH values

```{r, echo = FALSE}

mwh_check <- month_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(mwh_delivered == 0 | is.na(mwh_delivered) == TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::select(utility) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(utility) |> 
  dplyr::distinct()

if(nrow(mwh_check) == 0){
  
  print("All MWH values are valid. ")
  
} else{
  
  print("The following utilities have non-valid MWH values.")
  DT::datatable(mwh_check)
  
}

```

&&nbsp;
&&nbsp;

Here are the numbers of MWH values entered as either 0 or NA

```{r}
mwh_check <- month_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(mwh_delivered == 0 | is.na(mwh_delivered) == TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(invalid_type = ifelse(is.na(mwh_delivered) == TRUE, "Value is NA", "Value is 0")) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(invalid_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(count = dplyr::n())

DT::datatable(mwh_check)
```

&nbsp;
&nbsp;

These utility county values have fluctuated 200% or more compared to the average for that customer type over the last 3 years.

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "month_avg"}
WITH years_use AS (
	SELECT DISTINCT report_year
	FROM energy.month_customer_sales mcs 
	ORDER BY report_year DESC 
	LIMIT 3
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(m.utility_id, 'FM9999') AS utility_id, m.utility, m.month, m.customer_type, 
	ROUND(AVG(m.customer_count)) AS avg_customer_count, ROUND(AVG(m.mwh_delivered)) AS avg_mwh
FROM energy.month_customer_sales m
WHERE m.report_year IN (SELECT * FROM years_use) 
GROUP BY m.utility_id, m.utility, m.customer_type, m.MONTH
HAVING ROUND(AVG(m.customer_count)) IS NOT NULL AND 
	ROUND(AVG(m.customer_count)) != 0  AND ROUND(AVG(m.customer_count)) IS NOT NULL
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}

mwh_check <- month_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(mwh_delivered != 0 & is.na(mwh_delivered) == FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(month_avg, by = c("utility_id" = "utility_id", "utility" = "utility", "month" = "month", "customer_type" = "customer_type")) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(percent_diff = (mwh_delivered / avg_mwh) - 1, 
                numeric_diff = (mwh_delivered - avg_mwh)) |> 
  dplyr::filter(abs(percent_diff) >= 2 & abs(numeric_diff) > 100) |> 
  dplyr::select(utility, utility_id, month, customer_type, mwh_delivered, avg_mwh, percent_diff, customer_count, avg_customer_count) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(utility, customer_type, month)

DT::datatable(mwh_check)

```

&nbsp;
&nbsp;

Here are the specific utilities and customer types that had changes of over 200% in monthly MWH sales by customer type and an absolute change of at least 100 MWH. 

```{r, echo = FALSE}
mwh_check <- mwh_check |> 
  dplyr::select(utility, utility_id, customer_type) |> 
  dplyr::distinct() |> 
  dplyr::arrange(utility, customer_type)

DT::datatable(mwh_check)
```

&nbsp;
&nbsp;

These utilities had increases of at least 50 times greater than their previous 3 year average for a given customer class and month and had a change of at least 100 MWH.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
mwh_check <- month_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(mwh_delivered != 0 & is.na(mwh_delivered) == FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(month_avg, by = c("utility_id" = "utility_id", "utility" = "utility", "month" = "month", "customer_type" = "customer_type")) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(percent_diff = (mwh_delivered / avg_mwh) - 1, 
                numeric_diff = (mwh_delivered - avg_mwh)) |> 
  dplyr::filter(abs(percent_diff) >= 50 & abs(numeric_diff) > 100) |> 
  dplyr::select(utility, utility_id, month, customer_type, mwh_delivered, avg_mwh, percent_diff, customer_count, avg_customer_count) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(utility, customer_type, month)

DT::datatable(mwh_check)
```
